rulings.why: The page tells these changes from the row (`can`), or the judge could not tell (`unclear`), but no check of the shape readings does: movedown:1.3: can: Capitals do not tell it: p113-strip800.jpg system 2, stanza 1's row prints 'Omega' (a title of Christ) and the 'He' after it with capitals anyway. But the header (p113-strip0.jpg) prints the metre 8.7.8.7.8.7 (its end under a punch hole), and lines 3 and 4 count eight and seven syllables as the database lays them; moving the three-syllable word makes them five and ten, which the metre breaks.
